Graphic Design App

FashionCreative ToolsNative App

Pain Point

Gucci needed a custom solution to integrate Apple Pencil and iPad into its design workflow. The lack of a unified platform hindered seamless sketching, real-time collaboration, and efficient sharing of design iterations across teams, slowing down the product development cycle.

Solution

Etere Studio developed a specialized digital design platform for Gucci, integrating iPad and Apple Pencil into the fashion creation workflow. High-precision Apple Pencil support for sketching and intricate detailing Designer-centric UI for an intuitive, professional creative experience Customizable brushes, textures, and layering tools for realistic digital rendering Cloud-based synchronization to enable real-time sharing and cross-team collaboration

Highlights

  • High-precision Apple Pencil support for sketching and intricate detailing
  • Designer-centric UI for an intuitive, professional creative experience
  • Customizable brushes, textures, and layering tools for realistic digital rendering
  • Cloud-based synchronization to enable real-time sharing and cross-team collaboration
